user.title: Ambilight TV + Hue Sync
user.description: Philips Ambilight TV (Android / Google TV; TitanOS is untested) and Hue bridge addresses. After submitting, a PIN appears on the TV.

data.adb_source: TV source sensor via ADB (the TV asks once to allow debugging)

tv_pin.title: TV pairing
tv_pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on the TV.

hue_link.title: Hue bridge
hue_link.description: Press the link button on the Hue bridge, then submit within 30 seconds.

error.tv_unreachable: Could not reach the TV or start pairing.
error.bad_pin: Pairing failed (wrong or expired PIN). Go back and start again.
error.hue_unreachable: Could not reach the Hue bridge.
error.link_button: Link button not pressed. Press it and submit again.

abort.already_configured: This TV and entertainment area are already configured.
abort.no_areas: The bridge has no entertainment areas. Create one in the Hue app first.

activate_preset.name: Activate preset
activate_preset.description: Switch the Ambilight TV + Hue Sync preset (by name or id).
